d: MCP for Primavera P6: what it is and how it works

t: Primavera P6 with an AI assistant: guides
d: Each guide gives the prompts to type, the tools the assistant calls and real results from the public demo project DEMO-SS225, a 225/63 kV substation schedule with synthetic data.

t: DCMA 14-point check with AI in Primavera P6
d: Run the DCMA 14-point assessment on a P6 project from Claude, Cursor, VS Code or any MCP client, with the thresholds your project already has in P6, then drill into the activities behind each failed check.

t: Find the driving path in Primavera P6 with Claude
d: Ask Claude what drives an activity and get the chain of driving predecessors back to its root cause, computed from P6's own dates, then see where the total float comes from and test a change.

t: Compare two Primavera P6 updates with AI
d: Put this month's update next to last month's and ask what changed: activities and links compared one by one, the cause of each slip, float that eroded, and the changes a reviewer should question before accepting a better finish date.

t: AI review of a P6 XER file before submission
d: The monthly update XER is what the client sees. Check it the way their reviewer will, before it leaves: the file itself, the logic, the progress and what changed since the last submission. The same steps work when you are the reviewer.
